details: Analysis of supertokens-web@1.0.0 surfaced no a static rule matches and no behavioral findings indicating installer-side harm. The package name is close to the established SuperTokens family (supertokens-node, supertokens-website, supertokens-auth-react), which is a naming-confusion consideration a human reviewer may want to assess, but name similarity alone without a payload is not a supply-chain attack under this system's threat model. No exfiltration, install-time fetch-and-execute, silent-relay, credential distribution, dropper, or backdoor behavior was observed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
